mcq.q: Venn diagram mein A ∪ B kaisa dikhta hai?
mcq.explanation: Union mein A ya B (ya dono) ke saare elements aate hain, isliye dono circles poore shade hote hain.

mcq.q: Venn diagram mein A ∩ B kaun sa area hai?
mcq.explanation: Intersection sirf common elements hain, jo dono circles ke overlap mein hote hain.

mcq.q: A' (complement) Venn diagram mein kaun sa area hai?
options: Rectangle U mein circle A ke bahar
mcq.explanation: A' = U - A. Rectangle ke andar par circle A ke bahar ka area.

mcq.q: A - B Venn diagram mein kaun sa area hai?
options: A ka wo hissa jo B mein nahi hai
B ka wo hissa jo A mein nahi hai
mcq.explanation: A - B mein A ke elements hain jo B mein nahi hain, yaani circle A ka non-overlapping part.

mcq.q: A Δ B Venn diagram mein kaun sa area shade hota hai?
mcq.explanation: Symmetric difference mein wo elements hain jo sirf ek set mein hain, isliye overlap chhod kar dono circles ka bahar wala hissa.

mcq.q: Agar A ⊆ B hai, to Venn diagram mein circle A kahan hoga?
options: A aur B alag, bina overlap ke
A aur B ka size same
mcq.explanation: Subset mein A ke saare elements B mein hote hain, isliye circle A circle B ke andar aata hai.

mcq.q: Venn diagram mein do circles overlap nahi kar rahe. Sets kaise hain?
mcq.explanation: Jab circles overlap nahi karte, A ∩ B = φ, yaani sets disjoint hain.
A aur B mein koi common element nahi, isliye A ∩ B = φ (disjoint sets).

mcq.q: Kaunsa number rational hai?
mcq.explanation: 1/3 = p/q form mein hai (p = 1, q = 3).

mcq.q: Real numbers R kya hain?
mcq.explanation: R = Q ∪ I (rational aur irrational ka union).

mcq.q: {1, 4, 9, 16} ka set-builder form kaunsa hai?
{φ} mein kitne elements hain?
mcq.explanation: {φ} mein ek element hai: φ. Isliye ye null set nahi hai.

mcq.q: Kaunsa set infinite hai?
mcq.explanation: Natural numbers N ke elements count nahi ho sakte.

mcq.q: Disjoint sets ka Venn diagram kaisa hota hai?
mcq.explanation: Disjoint sets mein koi common element nahi, isliye circles overlap nahi karte.
Pehle A ka element, phir B ka element: (1, 3), (2, 3).
A ke elements jo B mein nahi: 1, 2.

mcq.q: A ∩ (B ∪ C) ke barabar kya hai?
mcq.explanation: Intersection distributive hai union par: A ∩ (B ∪ C) = (A ∩ B) ∪ (A ∩ C).

mcq.q: (A')' kya hai?
mcq.explanation: Complement ka complement original set deta hai.

mcq.q: Equal sets ka Venn diagram mein circles kaise hote hain?
options: Same position par, ek hi area
mcq.explanation: Equal sets ke sab elements same hain, isliye circles coincide karte hain.

mcq.q: A = {x, y}: P(A) mein kitne subsets hain?

short.q: Venn diagram mein A Δ B kaun sa area shade hota hai? Formula bhi likho.
short.answer: Dono circles ka non-overlapping part shade hota hai. A Δ B = (A ∪ B) - (A ∩ B) = (A - B) ∪ (B - A).

short.q: A = {1, 2, 3, 4, 5} aur B = {2, 4, 6, 7} ke liye A - B aur B - A likho.
U = factors of 48 = {1, 2, 3, 4, 6, 8, 12, 16, 24, 48}. A = factors of 24, B = factors of 12, C = factors of 8. A', B', C' likho.
Same U, A, B, C (factors of 48, 24, 12, 8): A ∪ B, A ∩ B aur A Δ B nikaalo.
Same U, B, C: (B ∪ C)' aur B' ∩ C' nikaal kar De Morgan verify karo.
short.answer: (B ∪ C)' = {16, 24, 48}; B' ∩ C' = {16, 24, 48}. Dono same hain, De Morgan verify.

short.q: Same sets (U = {1..10}, A = {1, 2, 4, 5}, B = {6, 7, 9, 10}): A ∪ B, A ∩ B aur A Δ B nikaalo.
Same sets (C = {1, 2, 9, 10}): (B ∪ C)' aur B' ∩ C' verify karo.
Same U, A, B, C = {18, 19, 20}: A' − B', B' − A' aur B' − C' nikaalo.
Same sets (U = {11..20}): A Δ B, C Δ B aur B ∩ C nikaalo.
U = {1..7}, A = {1, 2, 3, 4}, B = {3, 4, 5}. De Morgan se (A ∪ B)' aur (A ∩ B)' nikaalo.
A = {1, 2, 3}, B = {1, 2, 3, 4, 5}, C = {1, 4, 6, 7}. C − B aur C − A nikaalo, aur batao C − B ⊆ C − A kyon.
short.answer: C − B = {6, 7}; C − A = {4, 6, 7}. C − B ⊆ C − A kyonki A ⊆ B hai, isliye C − B, C − A ka subset hai.

short.q: N, Z, Q, I, R ka relation likho.
short.answer: N ⊂ Z ⊂ Q ⊂ R; I ⊂ R; R = Q ∪ I; Q ∩ I = φ.

short.q: {x ∈ N | x < 5} ko listing method mein likho.
{3, 6, 9} ko property (set-builder) form mein likho.
short.answer: {x | x ∈ N, x multiple of 3, x ≤ 9} (ya {x | x = 3n, n ∈ {1, 2, 3}}).

short.q: Finite aur infinite set ka ek-ek example do.
Subset A ⊆ B ka Venn diagram kaise banate hain?
short.answer: Circle A ko circle B ke andar banao, kyunki A ke sab elements B mein hain.

short.q: De Morgan ka use karke (A ∩ B)' ko A' aur B' ke form mein likho.
A = {1, 2, 3}, B = {x, y}: n(A × B) aur n(P(A)) nikaalo.
